var __defProp = Object.defineProperty;
var __name = (target, value) => __defProp(target, "name", { value, configurable: true });

// entry.mjs
import { WorkerEntrypoint } from "cloudflare:workers";

// ../../backend/cpu-placement.mjs
var python = `
import asyncio
import json
import sys
import sysconfig
import pyodide
from workers import WorkerEntrypoint, Response

class Default(WorkerEntrypoint):
    async def fetch(self, request):
        action = json.loads(await request.text())["action"]
        abi = {"python": list(sys.version_info[:3]), "pyodide": pyodide.__version__,
               "soabi": sysconfig.get_config_var("SOABI")}
        await self.env.EFFECTS.record("before")
        if action == "io":
            await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            await self.env.EFFECTS.record("after")
            return Response.json({"completed": True, "abi": abi})
        total = 0
        try:
            for value in range(200000000):
                total += value
        except BaseException as exc:
            await self.env.EFFECTS.record("caught")
            await self.env.EFFECTS.record("after")
            return Response.json({"caught": type(exc).__name__, "abi": abi})
        await self.env.EFFECTS.record("after")
        return Response.json({"total": total, "abi": abi})
`;
var CPU_CASES = Object.freeze(["completion", "code_limit", "entrypoint_limit"]);
var EVENTS = Object.freeze(["before", "caught", "after"]);
var API_ORIGIN = "https://bifrost-pyodide-dev-ui-ddf316c1.midtown-technology-group.workers.dev";
async function recordCpuEffect(api, token, caseId, event) {
  if (!CPU_CASES.includes(caseId) || !EVENTS.includes(event)) throw new TypeError("Invalid diagnostic event");
  const response = await api.fetch(new Request(`${API_ORIGIN}/api/sdk/runtime/logs`, {
    method: "POST",
    redirect: "manual",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ level: "INFO", message: `cpu-placement:${caseId}:${event}` })
  }));
  const accepted = response.status === 200;
  await response.body?.cancel();
  if (!accepted) throw new Error("Independent observer rejected event");
}
__name(recordCpuEffect, "recordCpuEffect");
async function runCpuPlacement(loader, effects, caseId) {
  if (!CPU_CASES.includes(caseId)) throw new TypeError("Unsupported CPU placement case");
  const code = {
    compatibilityDate: "2026-10-30",
    compatibilityFlags: ["python_workers"],
    mainModule: "main.py",
    modules: { "main.py": { py: python } },
    env: { EFFECTS: effects },
    globalOutbound: null,
    limits: { cpuMs: 1e3, subRequests: 4 }
  };
  const worker = loader.load(code);
  const entrypoint = caseId === "entrypoint_limit" ? worker.getEntrypoint(null, { limits: { cpuMs: 1e3, subRequests: 4 } }) : worker.getEntrypoint();
  try {
    const response = await entrypoint.fetch(new Request("https://attempt.invalid/", {
      method: "POST",
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: caseId === "completion" ? "io" : "cpu_catch" })
    }));
    return { case_id: caseId, status: response.status, body: await response.json() };
  } catch (error) {
    return { case_id: caseId, error_type: error.name };
  }
}
__name(runCpuPlacement, "runCpuPlacement");

// ../../probe-io.mjs
async function boundedText(response, maxBytes = 1024 * 1024) {
  const reader = response.body?.getReader();
  if (!reader) return "";
  const chunks = [];
  let size = 0;
  try {
    while (true) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      size += value.byteLength;
      if (size > maxBytes) throw new Error("Diagnostic response exceeds byte limit");
      chunks.push(value);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    await reader.cancel(error);
    throw error;
  } finally {
    reader.releaseLock();
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(size);
  let offset = 0;
  for (const chunk of chunks) {
    bytes.set(chunk, offset);
    offset += chunk.byteLength;
  }
  return new TextDecoder("utf-8", { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
}
__name(boundedText, "boundedText");
async function boundedJson(response, maxBytes) {
  return JSON.parse(await boundedText(response, maxBytes));
}
__name(boundedJson, "boundedJson");

// policy.mjs
function cpuProbeInput(body) {
  if (!body || typeof body !== "object" || Array.isArray(body) || Object.keys(body).sort().join(",") !== "case_id,run_token" || !CPU_CASES.includes(body.case_id) || typeof body.run_token !== "string" || body.run_token.length < 16 || body.run_token.length > 4096 || /[\r\n]/.test(body.run_token)) {
    throw new TypeError("Fixed CPU diagnostic only");
  }
  return { caseId: body.case_id, token: body.run_token };
}
__name(cpuProbeInput, "cpuProbeInput");
async function handleCpuProbe(request, env, makeEffects) {
  if (!env.DEV_AUTH || request.headers.get("X-Dev-Auth") !== env.DEV_AUTH || !(Date.now() < Number(env.DEV_EXPIRES_AT))) return new Response("Private qualification only", { status: 403 });
  if (request.method !== "POST") return new Response("POST required", { status: 405 });
  let input;
  try {
    input = cpuProbeInput(await boundedJson(request, 8192));
  } catch {
    return new Response("Fixed CPU diagnostic only", { status: 422 });
  }
  try {
    const response = await env.DEV_API.fetch(new Request(
      "https://bifrost-pyodide-dev-ui-ddf316c1.midtown-technology-group.workers.dev/api/sdk/runtime/logs",
      {
        method: "POST",
        redirect: "manual",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${input.token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ level: "INFO", message: `cpu-placement:${input.caseId}:parent-preflight` })
      }
    ));
    const status = response.status;
    await response.body?.cancel();
    if (status !== 200) return Response.json({ phase: "observer-auth", observer_status: status }, { status: 502 });
    const outcome = await runCpuPlacement(env.LOADER, makeEffects(input), input.caseId);
    return Response.json({ runtime: "deployed-cloudflare", outcome, physical_termination_verified: false });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ phase: "cpu-probe", error_type: error.name, physical_termination_verified: false }, { status: 502 });
  }
}
__name(handleCpuProbe, "handleCpuProbe");

// entry.mjs
var Effects = class extends WorkerEntrypoint {
  static {
    __name(this, "Effects");
  }
  async record(event) {
    await recordCpuEffect(this.env.DEV_API, this.ctx.props.token, this.ctx.props.caseId, event);
  }
};
var entry_default = {
  fetch(request, env, ctx) {
    return handleCpuProbe(request, env, (input) => ctx.exports.Effects({ props: input }));
  }
};
export {
  Effects,
  entry_default as default
};
